results.title: Sargeant Said to Exit Venezuela Oil Stake Amid Pressure Campaign
results.description: Harry Sargeant III, a Florida energy tycoon who served as a longtime back channel between Washington and Caracas, agreed to sell his interests in Venezuela’s second-largest oil producer following a pressure campaign to force him out.

results.title: Tungsten Mining flags major drilling program at Watershed Project
results.description: Tungsten Mining shares are in the spotlight as the company launches major drilling at its flagship Watershed Project in Queensland. The post Tungsten Mining flags major drilling program at Watershed Project appeared first on The Motley Fool Australia .
